blocks.text: Aap ne Grade X mein Mendel ki genetics ki buniyadi baatein parhi theen. Yeh chapter is khayal ko Mendel ke baad ki tehqeeq tak le jata hai, aur kuch moroosi (inherited) bimariyon, un ki alamaat aur ilaaj ko bhi dekhta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karein: khalis nasl ke paude
blocks.text: Austria ke rahib (monk) Gregor Johann Mendel ne sab se pehle virasat (inheritance) ka tareeqa samjhaya. Us ne matar ke khalis nasl (true-breeding ya pure-breeding) paude tayyar kiye: kisi khasiyat ke liye khalis nasl ka paudha khud-fertilization par sirf usi khasiyat wale bachche deta hai.

Mendel ne matar mein monohybrid crosses kiye, yaani aik waqt mein aik khasiyat dekhi. Pehle cross mein us ne beej ki shakal dekhi: jab khalis nasl ke gol beej wale paude ko jhurridar (wrinkled) beej wale paude se milaya to F1 nasl ke sab paudon ne gol beej diye.

items: Dominant khasiyat: woh khasiyat jo F1 paudon mein zahir hoti hai (gol beej).
Recessive khasiyat: woh mutabadil (alternative) khasiyat jo F1 paudon mein zahir nahi hoti (jhurridar beej).

blocks.prompt: Khalis nasl ke gol beej wale matar ko jhurridar beej wale se milaya. F1 beej kaise dikhenge, aur kaun si khasiyat dominant hai?
blocks.explanation: Sab F1 beej gol honge. Gol dominant hai kyunke F1 mein yahi zahir hoti hai; jhurridar recessive hai.

items: Khalis nasl ke paude khud-pollination par apne jaise hi bachche dete hain.
Gol x jhurridar se sab gol F1: gol dominant, jhurridar recessive.
